theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ) (lam ε : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u g : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < lam → IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 α u U → (∀ x ∈ U, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ ε) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 0 α g U → (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ Ψ (fderiv ℝ u x) (fderiv ℝ φ x) = -∫ x in U, inner ℝ (φ x) (g x)) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 2 α u U
